constraints_and_attribution.proposed_attribution: This work uses data sourced from Environment Canterbury.

coordinate_join.limitation: name aliases are a screening proxy; they are not authoritative catchment membership
coordinate_join.method: nearest NZTM2000-to-WGS84 point within 0.002 degrees, then station-name alias

recommendation.flow: include as contextual data if a selected catchment has a defensible station match; do not infer causation
recommendation.plausible_analysis_window: 2007-2024 is indicated by the catalog for several common parameters at some sites; completeness is not yet established
recommendation.preferred_screening_direction: Ashburton-Hakatere is the strongest quantitative screen; Waimakariri and Ashley-Rakahuri are smaller alternatives, all subject to polygon-based membership and observation-level checks

not_done: full observation download and quality/censoring profiling
licence approval for redistribution of every source derivative
owner selection of catchment, parameters, or analytical method
scope.surface_station_aliases: case-insensitive name matching after coordinate join
